What I do

Multilingual Desktop Publishing (DTP)

Flyers, manuals, brochures and many other kinds of documents laid out in every language. Same shape, same structure, same brand, a faithful mirror of the original source.

  • Right-to-left and CJK typesetting
  • Text expansion handled, layout intact
  • Editable source files and print-ready PDFs
+

eLearning Specialist

Storyline 360 and Rise courses, built or localized, that look and work like the original in every language. When the authoring tool isn’t enough, I adjust the published output with HTML, CSS and JavaScript, so every version says exactly what the original meant.

  • Interactions intact in every version
  • Player and fonts adapted per language
  • Course updates without starting over
+

Multimedia

Audio and video that speak every language. Subtitles, voice-over replacement and timeline sync, so every slide stays in step with its narration.

  • Subtitles burned in or as SRT/VTT files
  • Voice-over replaced and synced
  • Audio scripts ready for the studio
+
